slides.title: Copper peptide in your cream. Real or marketing?
GHK-Cu
slides.text: Three amino acids bound to copper. It occurs naturally in our blood, and its level drops with age.
Promising results in the lab and in animals. Large independent human studies are scarce.

slides.title: Watch out for
list: A cream is not a treatment
